source: Measured from live Google Calendar DOM (week view), 2026-10-14, dark theme
bodyFont: "Google Sans Text", "Google Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
notes: Hour rows are 48px; half-hour line is implicit (only hour gridlines drawn).
Event chips: solid calendar color, white 12px/500 text, 6px radius, ~4-6px inner padding, 1px gap between adjacent chips.
Hour labels 11px, right-aligned in a ~56px gutter, vertically centered on the gridline.
Day headers: 3-letter uppercase weekday (11px) over a large day number; today's number sits in a filled circle.
Re-measure in light theme before styling the light palette; colors above were sampled in dark mode.
